items.title: Visual page composition
items.outcome: Users can visually crop, insert, replace, interleave, merge, and reorder pages before downloading.
acceptance: Drag-to-crop has a visual preview and deterministic output geometry.
Pages from another PDF can be inserted or replace selected pages with explicit ordering.
Duplex interleaving and mixed-source merge preserve requested page order.
Output is independently reopened and page count/order is verified.

items.title: Original-page OCR fidelity
items.outcome: Scanned PDFs gain searchable/selectable text while preserving the original page appearance.
evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: OCR currently creates searchable raster reconstructions
acceptance: OCR can add an aligned invisible/searchable text layer without replacing the original page raster.
Users can review recognized regions and confidence before commit.
Search/reopen validation proves text is discoverable in the exported PDF.
Handwriting recognition is not claimed.

items.title: Preservation-aware page surgery
items.outcome: Page restructuring preserves document-level structures where supported and discloses breakage where it cannot.
evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: signatures and structures have explicit boundaries
acceptance: Bookmark, link/destination, form, attachment, and metadata effects are checked after restructuring.
Unsupported preservation paths fail closed or present a specific warning before download.
Digital-signature invalidation is never described as preservation.
Output-trust evidence reports which structures were preserved, changed, or dropped.

items.title: Searchable compression and target-size optimization
items.outcome: Users can reduce file size while retaining searchable/vector content when possible and can request a realistic target size.
evidence: docs/EVERYDAY_PDF_WORKFLOWS.md: searchable text-preserving recompression and target-size compression gap
acceptance: A structure-preserving compression path is attempted before raster fallback.
Target-size mode uses bounded iterations and reports when a target is unsafe or unattainable.
Before/after byte size and preservation summary are shown.
A larger output is never presented as a successful size reduction.

items.title: Batch parity and encrypted-input ergonomics
items.outcome: Reusable Batch recipes cover more high-value standalone tools and handle encrypted queue items safely.
evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: Batch does not expose every standalone tool
KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: per-file password prompts remain a gap
acceptance: The v7.2 Batch capability matrix explicitly lists supported and unsupported standalone tools.
Encrypted queue items can request per-file credentials without persistence.
Recipe/input changes invalidate stale outputs deterministically.
Multi-output steps are added only with explicit result semantics.

items.title: Compatibility and field qualification expansion
items.outcome: v7.2 changes are qualified against real-world difficult PDFs and representative external readers/devices.
evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: external reader/mobile/large/adversarial validation remains required
open issue #62: field qualification requires physical-device evidence
acceptance: Qualification includes malformed, scanned, form-heavy, encrypted, signed, and large real-world cases.
External-reader results are recorded with exact artifact identity.
Phone/tablet/installed-PWA observations are recorded where the affected workflow is supported.
A failed compatibility gate blocks release qualification rather than being converted into a documentation-only pass.

items.title: Complex-script shaping and bidi editing
items.outcome: Determine whether Arabic/RTL and other shaping-dependent existing text can be reconstructed faithfully in-browser.
evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: shaping-dependent scripts remain appearance-only fallback
acceptance: Promotion requires shaping/bidi design, font-subsetting plan, and a multilingual fidelity corpus.

items.title: Layout-aware DOCX interchange
items.outcome: Determine whether materially layout-aware DOCX interchange can meet PDF Studio fidelity standards.
acceptance: Promotion requires real layout/table/image/equation fidelity evidence and an explicit privacy decision for any upload service.

items.title: Dedicated touch document zoom
items.outcome: Determine whether two-pointer canvas zoom materially improves mobile editing without harming browser zoom/accessibility.
evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: dedicated two-pointer document zoom is not implemented
acceptance: Promotion requires phone/tablet usability evidence and no regression to browser accessibility zoom.

items.title: Full bidirectional Office suite conversion
items.reason: Too broad for v7.2 and risks false fidelity claims or a server dependency before the narrower DOCX spike is proven.

items.title: Browser certificate-store and PAdES signing
items.outcome: Certificate-backed cryptographic signing in the browser build.
items.reason: Native certificate stores/HSM integration remain outside the consumer browser runtime boundary.

items.title: Automatic full PDF/UA reconstruction
items.outcome: Infer a complete semantic accessibility tree from arbitrary visual PDFs.
items.reason: Current evidence supports inspection and bounded repairs, not reliable universal semantic reconstruction.

items.title: Unrestricted content-stream rewriting and enterprise/native expansion
items.outcome: Universal PDF object rewriting plus desktop/enterprise security platform expansion.
items.reason: Conflicts with the bounded consumer/local-first v7.2 objective and would dramatically expand risk and complexity.
